question: As per the 2011 census, which of the following union territories had the lowest population?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep** is the smallest Union Territory of India in terms of **population**, as per the **2011 Census**.
 
• The total population of Lakshadweep, according to the 2011 Census, was **64,429**.
 
• It is a group of **36 islands** located in the **Arabian Sea**, off the southwestern coast of India.
 
• The islands are known for their **pristine beauty**, **coral reefs**, and **marine biodiversity**.
 
• Kavaratti is the **capital** of Lakshadweep and also one of the most developed islands in the region.
 
• The Union Territory has a predominantly **Muslim population**, with **Malayalam** and **Jeseri** (a dialect of Malayalam) being the widely spoken languages.
 
• Tourism is a significant activity in Lakshadweep due to its **natural beauty**, but it is regulated to preserve the fragile ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**__

 __
 
• The **Andaman and Nicobar Islands** are located in the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• These islands are larger in terms of area and population compared to Lakshadweep.
 
• As per the **2011 Census**, the population was approximately **380,581**.
 
• Port Blair is the **capital** of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• These islands are known for their **tribal communities, dense forests, and historical significance**, such as the infamous **Cellular Jail**.
 
 
 
• **Chandigarh**__
 __
 
• **Chandigarh** is a Union Territory and the **capital city** of both Punjab and Haryana.
 
• It is known for its **modern architecture** and was designed by **Le Corbusier**, a Swiss-French architect.
 
• As per the **2011 Census**, Chandigarh had a population of approximately **1,055,450**.
 
• The city is also a hub for **education, industry, and administration**.
 
 
 
• **Puducherry**__
 
 
• **Puducherry**, formerly known as **Pondicherry**, is a Union Territory in southern India.
 
• It is known for its **French colonial heritage**, evident in its architecture and culture.
 
• As per the **2011 Census**, Puducherry had a population of approximately **1,247,953**.
 
• The Union Territory comprises four regions: **Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam**.
 
• The region is popular for its **beaches, temples, and Auroville**, an experimental township for sustainable living.
